customnarrator.config.title: Customizable Narrator
customnarrator.config.format.tooltip: How chat messages are read out by the Narrator.
customnarrator.config.separator.tooltip: Said between the name and the message, e.g. 'says' or ':'. Leave empty for none.
customnarrator.config.fallbackToReal: Use real name if no custom name
customnarrator.config.fallbackToReal.too: In Custom Name mode: players without a custom name are read with their real name. If off, only their message is read.
customnarrator.config.useCustomVoices.to: Uses your computer's speech voices so each player can sound different. Off = Minecraft's single narrator voice.
customnarrator.config.autoAssignVoices.t: Players without a chosen voice get one of your installed voices automatically (always the same one per player).
customnarrator.config.defaultVoice.toolt: Used when auto-pick is off and a player has no voice. Empty = system default. See /narratorvoice list
customnarrator.config.playerVoices.toolt: One per line: PlayerName=Voice Name (see /narratorvoice list)
customnarrator.config.voiceBackend.toolt: AUTO = Piper if installed, otherwise your computer's voices. Run /narratorvoice reload after changing.
customnarrator.config.piperPath.tooltip: Folder with piper.exe. Empty = look in C:\piper, Documents\piper, Downloads etc.
customnarrator.config.piperModel.tooltip: File name without .onnx. en_US-libritts_r-medium has 904 speakers.
